name: Stonks
author: Gaurav Chande
description: A stock watchlist plugin for the Omarchy 4 shell: today's move in your bar, and a chart you can scrub a click away.

barWidget.description: Today's move for your stocks, with a chart a click away.

schema.label: Bar pill
schema.description: How a bar along the top or bottom shows the featured symbol in its centre and left sections. Middle-click the pill to cycle.

schema.label: Bar pill on the right
schema.description: How a bar along the top or bottom shows the featured symbol in its right section, among the bar's icons. Middle-click the pill there to cycle.

schema.label: Bar pill on a side bar
schema.description: How a bar on the left or right of the screen shows the featured symbol: Stonks' mark, or the symbol over its change. Middle-click the pill there to switch.
